buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Scope of Work 1. The contractor shall maintain the equipment in good working condition during the contract period and s hall correct the fault and failure, repair or replace worn or defective parts of the equipment during normal working hours of the office ,where the equipment is installed. 2. Unserviceable parts will be handed over to HOD of used department/Store In-charge and same will be r eplaced with new original compatible parts of same machine. 3. The contractor shall ensure that the full configuration of the equipment is in proper working condition aft er repair and maintenance. 4. Preventive maintenance should be done Quarterly by qualified service engineer. 5. Maintenance service should be done within 48 hours of Breakdown call. 6. All spares should be verified by inspecting officer before installation. Term & conditions - Payment shall be done on Half yearly basis after rendering satisfactory quarterly service duly verified & s igned by institutional inspecting officer/HOD. - Submit the Bill/Invoice within 10 days of service/repair in triplicate along with service report duly signed b y HOD of the Concerned Dept. - Any material taken out from the Hospital campus shall have necessary permission from the competent a uthority in the form of gate-pass .

- The contractor shall provide the rate list of consumable items/spares including taxes etc. as given in the detail work which may be required time to time for repairs/maintenance. - No advance will be paid for AMC service. - The payment will be made only if Satisfactory performance report is obtained from concerned departmen t/authority/HOD. - No extra charges would be payable with regard to the labour deployed by the AMC contractor for rectifica tion of any defect arising in the equipment/machine as the same is included in the charges being paid for t he AMC contract. - Emergency Complaint/Call will be attended within 48 hours, failing which other Firms/agencies can be ap proached to repair the Machine/Equipment at the Risk & Cost of The Firm to which the AMC has been origi nally awarded - Calibration of equipment is to be done along with preventive service regularly. - Copy of each preventive maintenance service report dully signed by HOD will have to be sent to the AMC Branch (Medical Store). - Four preventive service at Quarterly interval and unlimited breakdown calls as and when required. - In case of any equipment/machine remains nonfunctional/non working more than seven days 1% of contr act value per week penalty amount will be deducted from the contract amount beside other Expenditures i ncurred on the same. - The continuation of order/Annual Maintenance contract will be subjected to the satisfaction of the Medical Superintendent and may be terminated at any time without assigning any reason. - It may be noted that in case there is any complaint/negligence received from Concerned Dept. during the period of repair/annual maintenance service. The maintenance contract will be liable to be terminated with immediate effect. .
